all_found.desc: [BUG] An orphaned legacy copy of a run marks seen[RunID], so a shared-store copy with the same RunID (both kept on an id collision) that belongs to this worktree reaches case seen and never becomes a blocker. A live abandoned run in this worktree escapes the Stop hook whenever a colliding legacy copy is orphaned.
